pregunta: ¿Qué productos se venden mucho pero están a punto de agotarse?
sql_generada:
SELECT p.product_name AS producto, st.quantity AS stock, st.quantity - (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM v_order_lines WHERE order_status = 4 AND product_id = p.product_id) AS stock_disponible
FROM products p
JOIN stocks st ON st.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE st.quantity < (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM v_order_lines WHERE order_status = 4 AND product_id = p.product_id)
ORDER BY stock_disponible DESC
LIMIT 10
